name: Company
text: Barley, Aurdin, Vivian and Lymen are all somewhere in Silverton. Find the others: the Hex, the mission chapel, vice row.
src: handoff-2026-09-23 §3 (the others hireable in play); hire spots invented.json#hires

name: Pete's Five
text: Across the river, the Crawler Warrens. Warrens Pete says six came up. The book has five names with no return line. Past the wet.
doneText: The five came back up. Edric wrote their return lines.

name: The Cull
text: West of town, the guano mine hires cull hands: three silver a giant-bat head, a gold piece a darkmantle. The one law: no fire under a roost.
doneText: You kept the law and brought a man up.

name: The Forty-Gold Tail
text: Forty gold on Hessle's board for the cloaker in the guano mine's deep gallery. Nobody has ever collected. Bright light is its weakness.
doneText: Hessle weighed the tail honestly and opened the drawer.

name: The Braiding Ettercap
text: Forty gold, up ten since it snared a lad: the ettercap at the far end of Web Gulch, south of the fork.
doneText: Hessle paid fifty gold. Nobody will ever say why it braided.

name: Fight Night
text: The Hex: five silver to fight on the card, winner keeps ten. Korvin keeps the slate. Talmok is the champion.
doneText: You beat Talmok on the sand.

name: The Snoot's Young Blood
text: Gnoll glory-seekers range south of the Halfway Inn. The challenge by day.

name: When You're Ready
text: Ambrose Winters, Acquisitions & Estates, Fountain Street. Not ready, not yet. (He will be ready when the one who leads you reaches level 4.)

name: What the Lake Keeps
text: The Halfway Inn, seventeen miles down the road. The Waterbys. The deep off the point.
doneText: The thing in the lake is dead.
